title: Digital Banking Customer Growth Manager - Business Banking
full_description:
At ING, our purpose is to empower people to stay a step ahead in life and business. Business Banking is a strategic growth pillar for us, and we’re on a mission to become thefirst choice for Australian entrepreneurs.
We’re looking for aDigital Banking Customer Growth Manager, Business Banking(internally known as a Customer Journey Expert, Easy Banking)to help shape and deliver exceptional end‑to‑end customer experiences for our Business Banking customers that drive digital sales.
This is a high impact role where you’ll will focus on customer acquisition, use a data led approach to uncover insights, and continuously optimize our customer journeys to improve conversion.
Drive the end‑to‑endcustomer growth strategy, identifypriority (sub)segmentsto target, provide deepcommercialandcustomer insightsthat result in digital sales opportunities
Inform and optimizeomnichannel acquisitionandconversion strategies(from onboarding through to in‑life engagement and cross‑sell) and work closely with marketing to execute across ATL, BTL, and Always On across digital and owned channels
Drivedata‑led decision makingandperformance analytics, building dashboards and insights to optimise conversion, retention, CPA and ROI
Shape and optimiseBusiness Banking propositions, using customer insights to improve relevance and value together with product / delivery teams
Partner with internal stakeholders (Marketing, Digital, Product, Customer Intelligence, IT, Delivery) and indirect stakeholders (Creative and Media Agencies – relationship managed by Marketing) to deliver seamless customer outcomes.
Influencesenior stakeholders, contributing to strategic direction through clear recommendations and executive storytelling
What we’re looking for
In-depth knowledge of the Business Banking segment, products and service model, P&L understanding, and 10+ years of experience
Proven track record delivering full‑funnel growth strategies, optimization initiatives resulting in commercial impact
Experience with product launches and/or working with Creative and Media Agenciesis highly advantageous
High level expertise in analytics, performance measurement and insight‑led optimisation
Experience leveraging marketing technology and personalisation platforms at scale
Confidence leading and influencing complex, cross‑functional stakeholder environments
A proactive, customer‑obsessedindividualwho combines strategic thinking with hands‑on execution
What’s in it for you?
Discounted ING Health Insurance
An additional Rest Day to support your wellbeing
An IMPACT day to volunteer on approved sustainability activity
At ING, we’re all about making life simpler and more rewarding - for the people who bank with us, the team members who work with us, and the communities we’re proud to support. Joining ING means stepping into an environment where your individuality isn’t just welcomed - it’s celebrated. We’ve built a culture that’s fun, inclusive, and supportive, giving you the freedom to be yourself, so you can do your thing.
Whether you’re taking ownership of exciting projects, thinking outside the box, or working with global colleagues, you’ll find ING is the kind of place where growth isn’t just a possibility; it’s a promise. As a WGEA Employer of Choice for Gender Equality and Family Inclusive workplace, you’ll feel the difference in how we value and champion our people.
We make hiring decisions based on your skills, capabilities, and how you align with our values - not on ticking every box. So, if you’re interested but don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply. We’re invested in fostering adiverse and inclusive workplacewhere everyone feels like they belong. We’re your allies in helping you do your thing during the recruitment process, so let us know (email below) if you require any support or adjustments when you apply
Sound like your kind of vibe? We can’t wait to hear from you!
(One last note: We operate using a direct talent sourcing model, so no agency introductions, please.)
ING is Australia’s most recommended bank according to RFI Global’s Consumer Atlas Survey, January–June 2025 (n = 29,510) when compared to customers of the 10 largest ADIs operating in Australia.
Contact: Skye Griffiths onskye.griffiths@ing.com
For support and adjustments, including DEI, LGBTQI+ confidential application support enquiries:rpoteam.au@ing.com
Applications close 6th February 2026
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position.
